content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    一轮圆月遥挂天际，几抹猩红染于上，沉得前方黑灰色的哥特式建筑如同鬼堡一般的阴森可怕。
这里是郊外，人烟罕至，却偏偏寸土寸金，因为这里空气清新，隔上几十米远便会出现一栋风格迥异的别墅，更何况在不久以后，这里将建成一个度假区。
阴风一呼而过，有一抹身影跌跌撞撞的从那栋哥特式大别墅中跑了出来，是一个少女，乌发凌乱，衣衫不整，她手上拿着一把刀，脸上和身上都带着血迹，不知道是她自己的还是别人的。
四周看不到人迹，她惊恐害怕的仿佛后面有鬼在追她，摔在地上，又滚爬着站起往外跑，光着的脚丫子踩在落了一地的落叶枯枝上，发出咔擦咔擦的声响。
铁门就在眼前，只要跑出去，只要再努力一点，一定可以逃出这个鬼地方……
后面有道身影缓缓的出现，她步子很慢，仿佛只是在月光下漫步，她慢慢的走向前面跌跌撞撞的往铁门外跑的女人，和她相比，她的步子实在很慢。
她嘴角带着笑，温柔美丽，诡异至极。
不要，不要过来！
前面的少女眼角挂着惊恐的泪，回头看到那抹身影，顿时吓得几乎腿软，但是她想要逃，她不要再落入这个变态的手上，她宁愿死也不要再落入她手上，所以她拿了刀，万一跑不掉，她就自杀！
她跑出了铁门，但是身后的女人却还在慢悠悠的追着她，在和她相距将近十米左右的地方。树叶发出沙沙响的声音，月光那么亮，可夜却那么黑，后面那抹身影就像一个逃不开的网，随时都可能把她捕捉回去做那种可怕的事，天啊！不要！
“噗通……”她摔了，手上的小刀滑出了半米远，她惊恐的抬头，看着不远处微笑着慢慢朝她走来的女人，害怕的全身颤抖，这个女人，比鬼更可怕！她一定是全世界最变态的人，一定是全世界最残忍可怕的女人，可偏偏这个女人，在全世界的眼中……
有一阵爽朗的笑声响了起来，还有女孩娇笑的声音，在这样寂静阴森的地方，显得十分的动人。
摔在地上的少女眼中迸发出希望的光芒，她颤抖着双唇捡起刀子往声音来源处跑去。
真不乖呐，不乖的人偶，上线要多上更多圈哦。
慢悠悠的走动的女孩嘴角笑容更深了一些，月光洒落在她面上，干净白皙，美丽柔和，天使一般的澄澈。
有一对情侣靠在停在路边的车身上喝啤酒打闹，忽的听到一阵急促的脚步声，一转头，看到一个头发凌乱手上拿刀身上脸上都带血的女人出现，在这个的月下，简直就像突然冒出的鬼一样，把他们吓到了。
“救命！”这鬼却对他们露出惊喜恳求的表情，跌跌撞撞的朝他们跑了过来，语气焦急惊慌，时不时的看看后面，“救命，求求你们，救救我！”
男人却吓得想要带女朋友上车跑掉，谁大半夜看到这样一个人不害怕，他们又不是武林高手。
“不要！求求你们救救我，我是人！我是人不是鬼！救救我！有人要杀我！”少女看出他们的害怕，连忙跪下来恳求，全身都在颤抖，她看着后面那缓缓从拐角处走出来的女孩，表情惊恐到扭曲的程度，她死死的扒住门把，就像抓住最后一根救命稻草，拼命的拉扯着想要把车门拉开，“你们看！那个人，她想要杀我！她要杀我！救救我！求求你们救救我！”
车灯很亮，坐在车内的情侣听到有人要杀人，而这要被杀的人都跑到自己面前求助了，自然不可能见死不救，可是少女手上拿着刀，所以想要先叫住在附近的哥们儿来帮忙，偏偏，他们看向那个被少女指着控诉的人的时候，怔住了，迟疑了。

如果这样的女孩会是杀人犯，那么这个社会真的太让人绝望了。
月光很明亮，车灯更明亮，而被车灯照亮的女孩穿着很干净的白色连衣裙，年纪看起来很小，未成年的样子，一头乌黑的发丝有些打卷，是很漂亮的自然卷，巴掌大的小脸上有些红润，长得十分的精致清秀，干净的叫人觉得有些不可思议，很干净，她的气质非常干净，天使一样。
“姐姐。”她脚步忽的快了起来，眉头微蹙，显得十分担忧。
姐姐？他们奇怪的看着这两人。
而这被称为姐姐的少女看着那女孩朝她大步的走来，吓得惊恐不已，她疯狂的拉扯车把，“不要！不要被她的脸骗了！她是骗子，她是一个变态！她屋里有许多很可怕的人偶尸体！她想要把我也做成人偶！救救我！救救我！”

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. A full moon hangs in the sky, with a few scarlet stains on it, making the black and gray Gothic building in front of it look as eerie as a ghost castle.
This is the suburbs, sparsely populated, but every inch of land is very valuable, because the air here is fresh, and a villa with a different style will appear just a few dozen meters away, not to mention that a resort will be built here in the near future.
The dark wind blew past, and a figure stumbled out of the large Gothic villa. It was a girl with messy black hair and disheveled clothes. She had a knife in her hand, and there was blood on her face and body. It was not clear whether it was her own or someone else's.
There were no traces of people around, and she was frightened as if there was a ghost chasing her. She fell to the ground, then stood up and ran out. Her bare feet stepped on the fallen leaves and branches that had fallen to the ground, making a clicking sound.
The iron gate is right in front of you. As long as you run out and work harder, you will be able to escape from this ghost place...
A figure appeared slowly from behind. Her steps were very slow, as if she was just walking under the moonlight. She slowly walked towards the woman in front of her who was stumbling towards the iron gate. Compared with her, her steps were really slow.
There was a smile on her lips, gentle, beautiful, and extremely weird.
No, don't come here!
The girl in front had tears of fear hanging from the corners of her eyes. When she looked back and saw that figure, she was so frightened that her legs almost weakened. But she wanted to escape. She didn't want to fall into the hands of this pervert again. She would rather die than fall into his hands again, so she took a knife. If she couldn't run away, she would commit suicide!
She ran out of the iron gate, but the woman behind her was still chasing her slowly, nearly ten meters away from her. The leaves made a rustling sound. The moonlight was so bright, but the night was so dark. The figure behind her was like an inescapable net that could catch her back to do such terrible things at any time. Oh my God! don't want!
"Plop..." She fell, and the knife in her hand slipped half a meter away. She raised her head in horror and looked at the woman not far away who was slowly walking toward her with a smile. Her whole body trembled with fear. This woman was more terrifying than a ghost! She must be the most perverted person in the world, the most cruel and terrifying woman in the world, but this woman, in the eyes of the world...
There was a burst of hearty laughter, and the girl's coquettish laughter sounded very moving in such a quiet and gloomy place.
The girl who fell to the ground had hope in her eyes. With trembling lips, she picked up the knife and ran towards the source of the sound.
You are so naughty. You naughty doll should go online more times.
The girl who was walking slowly had a deeper smile on her lips. The moonlight fell on her face, which was clean and white, beautiful and soft, and as clear as an angel.
There was a couple drinking beer and having fun while leaning on a car parked on the roadside. Suddenly they heard the sound of rapid footsteps. When they turned their heads, they saw a woman with messy hair and a knife in her hand, and blood on her face. In this moonlight, it was like a ghost that appeared out of nowhere, which frightened them.
"Help!" The ghost showed a surprised and pleading expression to them, and stumbled towards them, his tone anxious and panicked, looking behind him from time to time, "Help, please, help me!"
But the man was so frightened that he wanted to take his girlfriend into the car and run away. Who wouldn't be afraid to see such a person in the middle of the night? They are not martial arts masters.
"No! Please help me, I'm a human! I'm a human, not a ghost! Help me! Someone wants to kill me!" The girl saw their fear and quickly knelt down to plead, her whole body trembling. She looked at the girl behind her who slowly walked out of the corner, her expression twisted in horror. She clung to the door handle as if grasping the last life-saving straw, pulling desperately to open the car door."Look! That person, she wants to kill me! She wants to kill me! Help me! Please help me!"
The car lights were very bright. The couple sitting in the car heard that someone was about to kill someone, and the person who was about to be killed ran to them for help. Naturally, it was impossible to ignore death, but the girl had a knife in her hand, so they wanted to call the buddies who lived nearby to help first. However, when they looked at the person who was pointed and accused by the girl, they were stunned and hesitated.
If such a girl can be a murderer, then this society is really desperate.
The moonlight is very bright, the car lights are even brighter, and the girl illuminated by the car lights is wearing a very clean white dress. She looks very young and underage. Her black hair is slightly curled, which is very beautiful and naturally curly. Her palm-sized face is rosy, and she looks very delicate and delicate. She is so clean that it is incredible, very clean, and her temperament is very clean, like an angel.
"Sister." Her steps suddenly became faster, her brows furrowed slightly, looking very worried.
elder sister? They looked at the two people strangely.
The girl called sister looked at the girl striding toward her, and was so frightened that she pulled the handlebars frantically, "No! Don't be fooled by her face! She is a liar, she is a pervert! There are many terrible doll corpses in her house! She wants to make me a doll too! Save me! Save me!"
